title: CellPath-Bench: A Multidimensional Benchmark for Whole-Slide Cellular Representations in Pathology Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.21060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are increasingly used as general-purpose backbones, yet existing benchmarks cannot systematically diagnose their whole-slide cellular representation capabilities, including the decodability of cell-type information and the transferability of such information across tissue sections, datasets, and anatomical organs. We introduce CellPath-Bench, a cellular-resolution benchmark that evaluates frozen PFMs themselves. Following quality control of 52 candidate Xenium datasets, we construct a panel of 25 spatially aligned H\&E--Xenium tissue sections spanning 11 organs and 7,079,283 cells, harmonized into fine- and coarse-grained taxonomies. CellPath-Bench samples frozen WSI feature maps at registered nuclear coordinates and evaluates them using standardized multiclass linear probes. translated_title: CellPath-Bench：病理学基础模型中全切片细胞表征的多维基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21060v1 公告类型：新 摘要：病理学基础模型（PFMs）越来越多地被用作通用骨干网络，但现有基准无法系统性地评估其全切片细胞表征能力，包括细胞类型信息的可解码性以及这些信息在组织切片、数据集和解剖器官之间的可迁移性。我们引入了CellPath-Bench，一个细胞分辨率的基准，用于评估冻结的PFM本身。在对52个候选Xenium数据集进行质量控制后，我们构建了一个包含25个空间对齐的H&E-Xenium组织切片的面板，涵盖11个器官和7,079,283个细胞，并将其统一为细粒度和粗粒度的分类体系。CellPath-Bench在注册的核坐标处采样冻结的WSI特征图，并使用标准化的多类线性探针进行评估。细胞表征优势（CRA）衡量核锚定表征相对于块级表征在切片内的优势。
tldr: 本文提出了CellPath-Bench，一个多维基准，通过空间对齐的H&E-Xenium数据系统评估病理学基础模型的细胞级表征能力，并引入细胞表征优势（CRA）指标量化核锚定特征的优越性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CellPath-Bench, a multidimensional benchmark that systematically evaluates cellular-level representation capabilities of pathology foundation models using spatially aligned H&E-Xenium data, and proposes the Cell Representation Advantage (CRA) metric to quantify the superiority of nucleus-anchored features.
